items.en: Prinx Chengshan is preparing to broaden its European business through new Prinx passenger car and truck tyres, agricultural products and original equipment ambitions, supported by additional manufacturing capacity in Malaysia and China. Presenting its plans during Chengshan Group’s 50th anniversary celebrations and international dealer conference in October, the company outlined how it intends to build on the European business established with Austone and Fortune while developing a wider role for its flagship Prinx brand.

Having clocked up more than 30 years of experience, including playing a key role in the development of China’s first all-steel OTR tyres in the early 2000s, Xu Zhidong knows a thing or two about this specialist sector. That is why Prinx Chengshan asked him to lead its new plant in Rongcheng, China, which will soon begin supplying off-highway products to global markets. We met with the director of Prinx Chengshan’s OTR department when visiting the facility in October.
